about: The line audition's desktop machine: what the prompt line reads of a Void desktop in place of the machine the audition runs on, with made-up names. apps, folders, services and network are the picture's system part (SPARK_LINE_BENCH_MACHINE). programs are on the run's PATH beside the void snapshot's tools, and absent are taken off it: a desktop's own, and what its cases say is not installed. The grader takes programs for installed, their options unchecked. facts and now stand in for the machine folder's lines, as they ride: what a desktop writes there, its writer's line first.
facts: - The session is sway 1.10 (Wayland, not X11), set up by spark-shell v0.114. X11 tools do not work here.
- On Wayland it has grim and slurp for a screenshot, wl-copy and wl-paste for the clipboard, notify-send for a notification and swaymsg for sway.
- The bar is on top. Super+Space opens the dialog, the launcher and the settings; Super+c opens the chat.

- Keys: Super+Return a terminal, Super+q closes the window, Super+Escape locks, Print a screenshot, Shift+Print an area, Super+k the next keyboard layout, Super+1 to Super+9 workspace N, Super+Shift+1 to Super+Shift+9 moves the window to N, the volume and brightness keys.
- spark-shell theme NAME|none, theme save NAME, theme delete NAME, theme back, theme wallpaper NAME, theme text bigger|smaller, theme transparency more|less.
- spark-shell layout NAME, layout save NAME, layout rename NAME NEW, layout delete NAME, layout back.
- spark-shell notes, notes NAME, notes add WORDS, notes find WORDS; spark-shell reminders add DAY TIME WORDS, reminders done|snooze|delete|restore NAME.
- spark-shell font FACE SIZE|none, font list; spark-shell bar on|off; spark-shell dialog.
- spark-shell desktop keys, desktop lock, desktop capture screen|area|window, desktop display brightness N|up|down, desktop keyboard next, desktop screen NAME scale N|mode WxH|on|off.
- To read the state: spark mcp read NAME; swaymsg -t get_outputs, get_workspaces or get_tree; wpctl status; bluetoothctl show.
- Screens: DP-3 = Acme P15 (a portable monitor), on the left; HDMI-A-1 = Lumen 27Q, on the right. Both normal; DP-3 1920x1200@60Hz, HDMI-A-1 1920x1080@60Hz.
- Workspaces: 1 and 2 on HDMI-A-1, 3 on DP-3. swaymsg workspace number N goes to one.
- Sound out: HD-Audio Generic Digital Stereo (HDMI) is the monitor's speakers; Soundbar is a Bluetooth speaker; Headphones are Bluetooth headphones. Sound in: Webcam Mic, a USB microphone.
- Keyboard layouts: us (English, US), br (Portuguese, Brazil). Pointer: tap to click on, natural scroll off, speed 0.

- Saved layouts: writing. Notes: todo.md, groceries.md. Palettes: dark and light ones; none is the terminal's own colors. Saved themes: none. Wallpapers: the drawings and default. Savers: clock, spark, starfield, drift. Printers: office-laser.
now: - Windows open: con 14 foot (focused), con 21 firefox, con 27 mpv. Workspace 1 on HDMI-A-1 is focused.
- Sound: HD-Audio Generic Digital Stereo (HDMI) in use, volume 40%, not muted. Microphone: Webcam Mic connected, not muted. Bluetooth connected: none.
- Network: wired enp2s0 up with an address. Wi-Fi wlp3s0 connected to lab-5g.
- Keyboard layout us. Palette nord (dark), wallpaper fjord. Brightness 70. Idle screen after 10 minutes, lock after 15. No drive plugged. The bar is shown. Do not disturb is off.
